pairs.description: Bitter orange inhibits CYP3A4 and has been shown to increase blood levels of cyclosporine, so cyclosporine exposure may rise.
pairs.mechanism: Bitter orange inhibits CYP3A4 activity, which leads to increased blood levels of cyclosporine.

pairs.description: Bitter orange inhibits CYP3A4 and has been shown to increase blood levels of saquinavir, so saquinavir exposure may rise.
pairs.mechanism: Bitter orange inhibits CYP3A4 activity, which leads to increased blood levels of saquinavir.

pairs.description: Combining caffeine with bitter orange, another stimulant, can intensify caffeine's adverse effects, including tachycardia and seizures.
pairs.mechanism: Bitter orange contains synephrine, an alpha-adrenergic agonist, and combining it with caffeine can add to stimulant effects.
